questions.question: When David asked God not to bring him into judgment, what reason did he give?

answers.text: No one alive is righteous before God
He has never done anything wrong
His enemies should be judged first

questions.question: David said his soul was satisfied with God, like a well-watered garden. True or false?
David begged God not to hide His face from him. Whom did he say he would be like if God did?

answers.text: Those who descend to the Pit

questions.question: When David asked the LORD to revive him and bring him out of trouble, for whose sake did he ask?

answers.text: For the sake of God's name
For the sake of his family
For the sake of his army
